newsitem.title: USA: Lojack stake raised by Leon Cooperman.
newsitem.headline: Lojack stake raised by Leon Cooperman.

text.p: Investor Leon Cooperman said Thursday he raised his stake in LoJack Corp to 6.5 percent or 1,318,400 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Cooperman said he bought, through companies he controls, 61,200 additional shares of LoJack between November 12 and December 4 at prices ranging from $9.29 to $9.50 a share.

Cooperman manages several investment partnerships, including Omega Capital Partners L.P. He previously held a 5.2 percent stake in the Dedham, Mass.,-based company, which markets a proprietary system for locating, tracking and recovering stolen vehicles.
